title: The specified derived reduction adjunct is the transitivity isomorphism
statement: Fix ell,E,T,D and a coefficient-ring isomorphism e as in [def-sp-reduction-tower-data]. Suppose supplied an additive ordinary strict reduction functor with its D.scalar level identifications and pure-tensor quotient transition formula, and a universal left-derived functor red with counit computing on every K-flat complex and the displayed derived evaluations. Then for every integral derived object M, every actual D.reduction(m<=n) at red(M) is invertible. There is no qcqs, constructibility, Tor-bound or boundedness assumption.

source.place: Construction, normalization, and constructibility assertions; final Tor-amplitude sentence

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative. The computation counit identifies its image with the strict termwise tensor tower.

source.place: Construction, normalization, and constructibility assertions; final Tor-amplitude sentence

proof.text: Use D.reduction_rep and D.ordinaryReduction_eq. The transition formula identifies its tensor adjunct on pure generators with (x tensor c) tensor d mapping to x tensor quotient(c)*d. The normalized successive-scalar comparison has exactly this representative and inverse inserting one. Uniqueness of scalar models transports the comparison to the chosen D.

proof.text: Conjugate by computation counits and evaluation isomorphisms. Naturality along the representative isomorphism gives the result for every M. Equal indices are the tensor unitor and iterated indices use the same associative product.

lean.statement:
theorem sp_reduction_tower_adjunct_normalization
    (D : SpCoefficientTowersAbelian l E T)
    (coefficient : spIntegralSectionRing l E T ≅
      WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E T)
    (ordinary : spIntegralSectionModules l E T ⥤ spCoefficientTowers l E T)
    [ordinary.Additive]
    (level : spReductionOrdinaryLevels l E T D coefficient ordinary)
    (transition : IsSpReductionTransition l E T D coefficient ordinary level)
    (red : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ⥤
      spDerivedCoefficientTowers l E T D)
    (counit : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ red ⟶
      ordinary.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ spTowerLocalization l E T D)
    (universal : red.IsLeftDerivedFunctor counit
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) (.up ℤ)))
    (computes : ∀ P : CochainComplex (spIntegralSectionModules l E T) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := spIntegralSectionRing l E T) P →
        IsIso (counit.app P))
    (evaluation : spReductionDerivedEvaluations l E T D coefficient red) :
    ∀ M : DerivedCategory (spIntegralSectionModules l E T),
      IsSpNormalizedTower l E T D (red.obj M)
